def process_input_data():
    N = int(input())
    cards = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) + (i + 1,) for i in range(N)]
    cards.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
    
    _max_cost = float('-inf')
    not_discarded = []
    
    for strength, cost, index in cards:
        if cost > _max_cost:
            not_discarded.append(index)
            _max_cost = cost
    
    print(len(not_discarded))
    print(*sorted(not_discarded))
